title: A Passionate Pilgrim
summary: "A Passionate Pilgrim" by Henry James is a novella first published in 1871. American Clement Searle arrives in England, physically ailing and desperate to claim his share of an ancestral estate. As he pursues his vision of an English countryside home, fate intervenes with bitter irony.
